@graph.name: 5 Day Ijen, Papuma Beach, Tumpak Sewu & Bromo Nature Trip from Surabaya

review.reviewBody: One of the best tours I have been on so far, the itinerary was very well planned - the hikes paced out perfectly to ensure enough rest, time allocated in each attraction is also sufficient to really explore, the hotels & food are amazing, way beyond our expectations. Besides the great itinerary, the guides (Juan & Yandi) are amazing at bringing us around, extremely friendly and fun to be around. Lastly, Sam who helped to organise the tour is extremely helpful at solving all our needs pre, during and after the entire tour. Would highly recommend this tour package - 10/10!!!
